title: Smoky Sausage and Pepper Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful skillet dish featuring smoky sausage and bell peppers, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is easy to make and packed with protein and fiber.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the smoky sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausage from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced bell peppers and onion to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Return the sausage to the skillet and stir in the German mustard.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the sausage and peppers hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve with bread or over rice, if desired.
